judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.error: the check for 'pytest-timeout is not already declared' iterated over requirements.txt / pyproject.toml / setup.cfg / pytest.ini / tox.ini -- NONE of which exist in this repository -- so it searched zero files and reported False
judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.fix: look where the fact actually lives: the CI install line in .github/workflows/quality.yml. Also add a hard gate so that if nothing was searched the proposition FAILS instead of passing vacuously.
judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.note: the corrected check confirms the dependency really is absent, so the ruling's premise holds -- but the first False reached that answer by luck, from a judge pointed at nothing
judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.why_it_is_bad: an empty scope reported as a negative finding. 'I did not look' and 'I looked and it was not there' have the SAME shape in the output.

judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.error: p4['holds'] folded every boolean into one all(), including the deliberately NEGATIVE assertion `pytest_timeout_already_declared`, which we WANT to be False
judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.fix: name the required polarity explicitly and record why the negative one must not be folded in
judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.generalisation: the value we WANT and the value that is TRUE are not the same thing; a proposition mixing negative assertions cannot be summarised as 'all booleans true'
judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.symptom: every individual fact was True and correct while `holds` stayed False
judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.why_it_is_bad: the proposition became structurally unsatisfiable: it demanded both that the dependency be absent (the premise) and that this absence count as satisfied

judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.error: the text matcher required single spaces, but the reviewer's prose hard-wraps mid-sentence, so it failed to cross the line break
judge_errors_made_and_fixed_in_this_card.note: this is the same trap this card's predecessor wrote into the skill one round earlier; the skill said 'normalise whitespace' and I normalised only [ \t]+, forgetting \n. Writing a lesson down is not the same as applying it.
